title: Restore workflow continuity and release readiness
summary: Fix phase-continuous recommendation, lifecycle E2E coverage, and stable version/tag automation before promotion.
description: This phase addresses the release blockers rooted in `packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts:134-141`, `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1425-1440`, `e2e/status-dashboard.spec.ts:20-46`, `scripts/release.cjs`, and `.github/workflows/publish.yml`. Current selection abandons the last active phase for global priority, resume focus may select an unrelated derived in-progress phase, Playwright uses a prohibited generic in-progress transition, and stable version discovery has no Git tag source. Work must preserve active/resume/deviation/checkpoint precedence, explicit task-start eligibility, unified package versions, `next` as the experimental channel, `develop` as stable staging, and user-only GitHub PR merges. Dependencies: existing T325 lifecycle endpoint/UI and T326 context gates. Complete only after focused regressions, full unit/coverage, Playwright E2E, build, check, and whitespace validation pass.

acceptedDecisions.title: Current phase continuity precedes global priority
acceptedDecisions.decision: After active work, deviations, and checkpoints are handled, task recommendation must continue a ready task in resume.currentPhaseId before considering global feature → phase → task priority. The resume pointer must follow the phase containing actual active task work and remain as continuity context after completion.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: T438 completion incorrectly led to T374 in another phase while T439 remained ready in P082 because the selector ignored phase continuity and refreshResume could choose the first merely derived in-progress phase.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Keep TaskRecommendationKind unchanged for public compatibility. Pass currentPhaseId as an optional fourth recommendNextTask argument. Fall back globally only when the current phase has no ready task. Preserve explicit-start behavior and active/resume/deviation/checkpoint precedence.

acceptedDecisions.title: Stable versions are anchored by annotated Git tags
acceptedDecisions.decision: Stable releases use the latest strict annotated `vX.Y.Z` Git tag as their version base and automatically bump it when no explicit version is supplied. Until the first canonical tag exists, release.cjs falls back to stable unified package versions on origin/main. Successful main publication creates the tag; next publication never does.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Develop may legitimately contain `-next.N` versions, so deriving a stable default from current workspace package strings is ambiguous. Tags represent completed stable releases, while the origin/main fallback safely bootstraps the repository because no tags currently exist.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Fetch origin develop/main plus tags during release preflight. Abort if an existing latest stable tag disagrees with origin/main. Keep explicit X.Y.Z and patch/minor/major modes with downgrade guards. GitHub Actions receives contents:write only to push the stable tag after all npm publish steps succeed.

tasks.title: Keep next-task recommendations in the current phase
tasks.description:
Modify `packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts:82-142` so active/resume/deviation/checkpoint precedence remains unchanged, then prefer ready tasks belonging to an explicitly supplied current phase before global feature → phase → task priority. Correct `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1425-1440` so `resume.currentPhaseId` follows the phase containing the actual active task and remains stable after task completion rather than selecting the first derived in-progress phase. Pass validated resume focus through Pi, MCP, and server recommendation call sites. Add regression tests proving that a lower-numbered/high-global-priority task in another phase cannot displace the next ready task in the phase just worked, while blocked/exhausted current phases fall back globally. Preserve explicit task starts, deviations, checkpoints, and public recommendation result kinds.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented phase-continuous task recommendation. `packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts` accepts an optional currentPhaseId and, after active/resume/deviation/checkpoint precedence, selects the highest-priority ready task in that phase before global priority without changing public recommendation kinds. `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` now sets resume.currentPhaseId from the phase containing actual in-progress task work, preserving it after completion. Pi, MCP, and HTTP lifecycle callers pass persisted resume focus. Added core regressions reproducing T374 vs T439, fallback behavior, precedence preservation, active-phase resume focus, and MCP structured behavior. Focused builds, 39 tests, and pnpm check passed.

tasks.title: Derive stable releases from canonical Git tags
tasks.description:
Harden `scripts/release.cjs` so a parameterless stable release fetches tags, discovers the latest canonical `vX.Y.Z` stable tag, and bumps it automatically; when no stable tags exist, fall back safely to unified versions read from `origin/main`. Preserve `patch|minor|major` and explicit `X.Y.Z` targets with downgrade guards, and ignore `-next.N` versions on develop for stable-base calculation. Add a pure version-selection helper and root integration tests. Update `.github/workflows/publish.yml` so a successful stable publish from main creates/pushes the matching tag if absent, while next publishes never tag. Align `README.md` and the explicitly user-requested `AGENTS.md` release rules. Do not change branch roles or allow automated PR merging.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added `scripts/release-version.cjs` with strict stable-semver parsing, numeric stable tag selection, stable-only origin/main fallback selection, level bumps, explicit targets, and downgrade guards. `scripts/release.cjs` now fetches develop/main/tags, uses canonical vX.Y.Z tags or origin/main bootstrap fallback, ignores develop prerelease suffixes, and aborts on tag/main disagreement. `.github/workflows/publish.yml` tags successful stable main publications only after all package publishes succeed and never tags next. Updated README.md and explicitly requested AGENTS.md release rules, including prior release-reading safeguards and correction of stale next/plugin documentation. Added `test/release-versioning.test.mjs` (6/6 passing); node syntax checks, YAML parse, and git diff whitespace validation passed.
